{{Top}}
A '''sculptor''' was an [[Artist/Legends|artist]] who specialized in creating in sculptures. [[Balinaka]] [[Artisan/Legends|artisan]] sculptors were integral to the creation of [[Garnib crystal]], as they created the initial sculptures around which the work of art was based.
